desc: 背带束卷一提就走，条纹垫面与居家训练场景的健身垫主图套图
leaf: 带背带条纹发泡健身垫
name: 背带束卷条纹发泡瑜伽垫款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼看清卷垫本体与自带背带，赢取点击且平台合规
一秒传达卷垫自立不散的挺度价值，规格主张留空位
对照徒手抱垫滑落的尴尬，凸显束带提携的解决感
把背带换算成真实出门动线，让用户代入居家带垫通勤
平铺使用场景建立自我代入，展示垫面铺展与居家适配
微距证明条纹面与圆角断面的做工，替代厚度数值主张
同框多色可选让买家快速锁定心仪配色
以完整平铺比例与空白规格收口，消除尺寸与售后疑虑

style.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF for packshots and the closing flat layout, mist-grey panels #E9EAE6 and #E3E6E3 for benefit and pain-point screens, cobalt blue #1D4E9E only for the colourway lineup
style.iconSystem: thin-line single-weight icons in the cobalt accent #1D4E9E, empty rounded seal frames instead of rendered badges
style.lightingSystem: neutral-cool studio light, front-left key with a large soft fill, single consistent shadow direction, honest contact shadows, bright even high key on flat layouts
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean utilitarian fitness-retail visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, mist-grey panel #E9EAE6, charcoal product tone #2C2E30 and one cobalt blue accent #1D4E9E; neutral-cool studio lighting with a front-left key, large soft fill and honest contact shadows in one consistent direction; modern geometric sans-serif reserved for downstream copy only so the frames stay text-free; consistent thin-line single-weight icon style with empty rounded seal frames instead of rendered badges; clean high-end product photography mixed with bright lived-in home-corner lifestyle scenes; rolled units always shown as neat tight cylinders with spiral ends readable and flat units taut and wrinkle-free with rounded corners fully inside the frame; stable product scale, centring and one light direction per frame; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no rendered text or badges.
noDrift: no rendered text, badges or star ratings
style.presentationRules: rolled units shown as neat tight cylinders with spiral ends readable, flat units taut and wrinkle-free with rounded corners fully inside frame, stable scale and centring across the set
style.surfaceSystem: seamless studio sweep for product screens, pale wood floor #E3CFB6 and warm off-white wall #F1EBE2 in lifestyle scenes
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif reserved for downstream copy only, the frames themselves stay text-free with empty pill and line placeholders
